model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates an "effect" measured across various linguistic categories labeled "family." The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are arranged in alphabetical order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "effect" values on a linear scale, extending from slightly below 0 to above 30, with numeric tick labels provided at 0, 10, 20, and 30, accompanied by corresponding horizontal grid lines spanning the chart. Within each family category on the horizontal axis, the data is presented as a group of six adjacent vertical bars. According to the legend located on the right side of the chart, these bars are color-coded to represent different models and conditions: "mBERT-L₂" is shaded light blue, "XLM-L₂" is greyish-blue, "mBERT-R₂" is light green, "XLM-R₂" is darker green, "mBERT-B₂" is light pink, and "XLM-B₂" is darker red-pink. Every bar is visually emphasized with a solid grey outline and is overlaid with a vertical grey error bar extending above and below its top edge. The bar values vary widely; the tallest bar reaches approximately 24 for the mBERT-B₂ model in the IE-Indic family group, while several bars dip below the zero baseline, most notably the mBERT-R₂ bar in the Semitic family group, which measures approximately -3.
